items.title: Live: Littleproud to meet with Ley after seeing off leadership challenge
items.description: Nationals leader David Littleproud has seen off a leadership challenge after a spill motion against him failed. Follow live.

items.title: The economy should be the focus but Coalition incompetence is a gift to Labor
items.description: The trip to the tennis is a sign of the PM's own sense of confidence. It's a move that is only made by a man who clearly has his mojo back.

items.title: Victorian police reveal they 'strongly believe' fugitive Dezi Freeman is dead
items.description: Victoria Police will spend five days scouring a remote section of Mount Buffalo National Park in the state's north-east as part of a renewed search for fugitive Dezi Freeman.

items.title: 'Shattered' family members recount the day of terror at Bondi
items.description: Survivors, grieving family members and those who ran towards danger describe, in their own words, what they witnessed as the Bondi attack unfolded.

items.title: Norway's monarchy, besieged by scandals, braces for the biggest one yet
items.description: This week, Marius Borg Høiby, the stepson of Norway's future king, will face trial on a string of rape, drug and abuse charges, and it has the whole country talking.

items.title: Live: ASX down as gold miners tumble on precious metals rout
items.description: The local stock market is in the red, led by hefty falls for gold miners as precious metals continue to react negatively to the announcement of the US Fed chair. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: What are the chances the RBA will raise interest rates?
items.description: The market thinks the RBA is likely to lift interest rates tomorrow, but the market has been wrong before.

items.title: At 11, Caitlan was homeless — and hundreds of children still are
items.description: A coalition calls for action to help the "huge hidden population" of young people in Western Australia who are experiencing homelessness, with children left feeling ashamed and alone even in the safety of school.

items.title: Cancer forces ABC radio presenter James Valentine to retire from the airwaves
items.description: The veteran broadcaster, known for his humorous talkback segments, has omentum cancer and had surgery for oesophageal cancer in 2024.

items.title: Live: Grammys 2026 live: Billie Eilish wins Song of the Year, condemns ICE
items.description: The 24-year-old took out the gong at the 68th Grammy Awards for her song Wildflower, with Lady Gaga and Olivia Dean also winning awards at the ceremony.

items.title: High-flying travel CEO leaves amid overcharging scandal
items.description: Corporate Travel Management boss Jamie Pherous has exited from all his executive and board roles as he moves to a "strategic advisory role."

items.title: Former NRL player's child assault case before Queensland court
items.description: The case against a former Queensland State of Origin player accused of assaulting a child has come before a court for the first time.

items.title: Five-year-old boy detained by ICE returns to Minnesota
items.description: Five-year-old Liam Conejo Ramos, whose detention by federal agents as he returned from preschool sparked outrage across the United States, has been released from immigration detention, according to a US congressman.

items.title: Sydney police officer allegedly assaulted pair over 'knock and run' game
items.description: A senior police officer is accused of arming himself with a bat and assaulting a pair of young men who knocked on his front door and hid.

items.title: With so much PCOS advice online, how can we avoid the 'nonsense'?
items.description: Advice on how to "manage", "treat" and "heal" PCOS is easy to come by online, but experts say a more personalised approach is usually what's needed.

items.title: When an icebound town faced an outbreak, these dogs became heroes
items.description: Children of an icebound Alaskan town were dying. The journey to save them would be treacherous, freezing, and in these dogs' paws.

items.title: Matildas trio help Arsenal to become first-ever club world champions
items.description: Arsenal have become the first women's world soccer champions, with Matildas star Caitlin Foord clinching the title for the Gunners in extra time.

items.title: Liberals expect leadership spill against Ley as early as next week
items.description: Leadership speculation has engulfed both the Liberal and National parties since the minor party walked away from the Coalition agreement two weeks ago.

items.title: Grandparents left in disbelief and frustrated by family law system
items.description: Many grandparents are parting with hundreds of thousands of dollars to help support their adult children through family law matters, in turn impacting their own financial security in retirement.

items.title: Further charges unlikely in Epstein case, top prosecutor says
items.description: Deputy Attorney-General Todd Blanche says the existence of "horrible photographs" and troubling emails in the latest cache of released files does not necessarily mean prosecutions can go ahead.

items.title: Iran's supreme leader warns US attack would start 'regional war'
items.description: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei issues his most direct threat yet following the deployment of US warships to the Arabian Sea.

items.title: Prominent charity cuts ties with founder over alleged sexual assault, rape
items.description: One of south-east Queensland's most well-known charities has cut ties with its founder after he was charged with numerous sexual assault and rape offences over the weekend.

items.title: Bree Walker wants the pressure of competing for Olympic gold
items.description: The g-force felt hurtling down the bobsleigh track is the only pressure Bree Walker is feeling despite the Australian speed demon entering the Winter Olympics as one of the gold-medal favourites.

items.title: Dinosaur footprint found in Brisbane quarry more than 60 years ago identified
items.description: A fossilised dinosaur footprint that lived in a professor's personal collection for more than six decades has been identified.

items.title: Taxpayer-funded Brisbane theatre completed after four-year delay
items.description: The Glasshouse Theatre will open next month for a community open day before Queensland Ballet takes the stage after a series of delays.
